busyMerge: A merge is not finished. Continue or abort it first.
busyRevert: A revert is not finished. Continue or abort it first.
busyCherryPick: A cherry-pick is not finished. Continue or abort it first.
busyRebase: A rebase is not finished. Continue or abort it first.
firstCommit: The first commit of a repository cannot be undone this way.
merge: The last commit is a merge. Reset the branch to the commit you want instead.
